# Vendored libraries

| Library | Version | Licence | Used by | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Leaflet](https://leafletjs.com) | 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause (`leaflet/LICENSE`) | `editor/` | `dist/leaflet.js` + `dist/leaflet.css` only; no marker images (unused). Update by re-downloading from unpkg and checking the sha256 in the #169 plan. |
| [ALTCHA widget](https://altcha.org) (`altcha` on npm) | 3.3.0 | MIT (`altcha/LICENSE`) | `editor/human.js` | `dist/main/altcha.min.js` only (styles and PBKDF2/SHA workers inline, no i18n bundle: the page shows its own de/en text). Proof-of-work human check for #168's `POST /api/jobs`; self-hosted, no cookies, no third party. Must match #168's server library (`altcha` on PyPI, PoW v2). Update by re-downloading from unpkg and checking the sha256 in the #169 plan. |
| [crashcat](https://github.com/isaac-mason/crashcat) (`crashcat` on npm) + its one dependency [mathcat](https://github.com/isaac-mason/mathcat) 0.0.13 | 0.0.5 | MIT (`crashcat/LICENSE`, `crashcat/LICENSE.mathcat`) | `prototype/tyres.js` | One self-contained ES module, `crashcat/crashcat.min.js` (about 194 KB, crashcat and mathcat bundled and minified, sha256 `8f3fae0e18fe2f8c57b9cd60628cd7191317400e75d7bde8e97b1aaa2ac8d67a`). Loaded lazily with `import()` and only when a tyre stack is placed (#416). Pinned to 0.0.5: the API is 0.0.x and changes between releases, so do not bump casually. Built outside the repo (no `package.json` or `node_modules` here): `npm i crashcat@0.0.5 esbuild`, then `esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --legal-comments=none --outfile=crashcat.min.js` with `entry.js` being `export { addBroadphaseLayer, addObjectLayer, enableCollision, createWorld, createWorldSettings, updateWorld, registerShapes, rigidBody, cylinder, box, MotionType } from 'crashcat';` (only the shapes the game needs; the rest is tree-shaken away). |
